content.title: How to watch Utah State vs. Arizona men’s basketball: Second Round TV channel and streaming options for March 22
content.text: The No. 1 seed Arizona Wildcats (33-2) try to advance to the Sweet 16 of the NCAA Tournament when they face the No. 9 seed Utah State Aggies (29-6) on Sunday at 8:10 p.m. ET.How to watch Utah State Aggies vs. Arizona Wildcats Venue: Viejas Arena Time: 8:10 p.m. ET TV: truTV Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Stats to know Arizona averages 86.3 points per game (12th in college basketball) while giving up 68.5 per contest (46th in college basketball). It has a +624 scoring differential overall and outscores opponents by 17.8 points per game. Arizona hits 5.9 three-pointers per game (334th in college basketball), 1.4 fewer than its opponents (7.3). It is shooting 36.2% from deep (51st in college basketball) while allowing opponents to shoot 31.4%. Utah State is outscoring opponents by 12.1 points per game, with a +424 scoring differential overall. It puts up 82.6 points per game (42nd in college basketball) and allows 70.5 per outing (80th in college basketball). Utah State connects on 8.4 three-pointers per game (123rd in college basketball) compared to its opponents’ 7.8. It shoots 35.4% from deep, and its opponents shoot 34.3%.
